d: Prabhu sets out to find his lost bike, only to discover it's being used for drug smuggling. What will he do?
Kittu kidnaps Saitji's daughter, Nandu, to get his money back, but Nandu is too happy to be kidnapped.
A singer is shocked when a pretty woman pursues him, claiming to be his girlfriend, and then his wife.
Lord Narayana sends Narada to Earth to test a devotee's will, sparking clashes among the faithful.
